# Item locations: Pokémon Sapphire NDS

Items on the ground (item balls), hidden items (use the Itemfinder, or press A on the spot) and the daily berry spots, by area. Gifts from people and shops are not listed here; the TMs people give are on the [TM page](tms-and-hms.md).

Berry trees work as in Gen 3: pick a ripe tree, then plant any berry in the soft soil (talk to it) and water it with the Wailmer Pail (from the flower shop on Route 104). Trees grow by the DS clock. The list shows what each spot holds at the start of a new game.
